title: Distribution of a fixed coordinate set under a random restriction
hypotheses_covered: rho a Bernoulli(p) random restriction with free set J
event: U intersect J equals S
replaced:
For a Bernoulli($p$)-random restriction $\rho$ with free set $J = \rho.\mathrm{freeVars}$
and sets $U, S \subseteq [n]$,
\[
  \Pr_\rho\bigl[U \cap J = S\bigr] \;=\;
  \begin{cases} p^{\abs{S}}\,(1-p)^{\abs{U \setminus S}} & S \subseteq U,\\
  0 & \text{otherwise.}\end{cases}
\]
Combined with the second identity this yields O'Donnell's form
$\E_\rho[\widehat{f_\rho}(S)^2] = \sum_U \Pr[U \cap J = S]\cdot \widehat{f}(U)^2$.
